value.message: Depending on your previous selection, you may either schedule or reschedule your upgrade. You can choose to manually reschedule your upgrade below. Once the upgrade begins, you can view the progress of the upgrade allowing you to estimate how long the upgrade might take. You can view the upgrade summary once the upgrade is complete.
Your upgrade is complete. See below for summarized details.
Some items are still loading in the background. Depending on the upgrade scenario this will take several minutes.
The trigger for schema alters will be available after 24 hours schedule is submitted

A “Schema Alter” refers to changes made to the database structure, such as modifications to tables or fields, during an upgrade. These changes are necessary to support new platform features. These schema alters can now be isolated and pre-staged prior to your scheduled upgrade allowing you to control the windows in which associated features are lost.

Schema alteration must be scheduled between the last Saturday prior to the 4-day pre-upgrade window and 4 days before the scheduled upgrade. Saturday scheduling is recommended to minimize potential performance impact on business operations.
Schema Alters must be scheduled within the maintenance window between the last Saturday and 4 days before scheduled upgrade date.
Your upgrade session will be reloaded with new playbook experience, this may take few moments.
Reloading new session, this may take few moments
